spec-01-c3.text: Northwestern University IMSERC. Protein NMR guide (eNMR), NOE section. Northwestern University Integrated Molecular Structure Education and Research Center.
spec-01-c3.quote: NOEs usually are observed only for proton pairs separated by 5-6 A.
spec-01-c3.claim: NOE intensities scale as r−6, which turns 2D NOESY spectra into a distance ruler used to determine solution structures of proteins
